description: One owner per concept. Both callers sort, validate and derive a value before calling; adding a third caller must move that work inside the module rather than copy it a third time.
rubric: Every caller of `schedule_backup` in the input repeats three steps before the call: it sorts the volumes largest first, checks that the window ends after it starts, and computes `duration_minutes` from the window. PASS only if the revised code performs each of those three steps once, inside `schedule_backup` or a function it calls, and none of the three callers (`schedule_weekly`, `schedule_monthly`, `schedule_nightly`) performs any of them. Dropping the `duration_minutes` parameter is expected, because the module can derive it. A helper that the callers must remember to call before `schedule_backup` does not count as moving the step inside. FAIL if any caller in the reply still sorts, validates the window or computes the duration; quote that caller's line.
